links.title: Checked links
links.description: One row per unique checked link (plus page and error rows). In crawl mode, problem links are written first.

fixList.title: Fix list
fixList.description: Source page, anchor text, link URL, status and failure reason for each link.

brokenLinksCsv.title: Broken links report (CSV)
brokenLinksCsv.description: One line per source page and link that is broken, restricted, unverified or skipped: source page, anchor text, link URL, status code, error code.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Per-site counts by status and error code, skipped and not-checked counts with reasons, mailto/tel counts, charged events.
